name: SBS Certified Business List
description:
This dataset is a directory of certified minority- and women-owned business enterprises (MWBEs), most likely firms certified through a New York City small business program. Each row represents one certified vendor and includes its account number, formal name and DBA, contact person, phone, website, business description, and full mailing and physical addresses. Certification details include the certification type (MBE, WBE, EBE, or combinations), renewal date, ethnicity, and date of establishment.

The data also covers industry and capacity: six-digit NAICS codes with sector, subsector, and title; aggregate bonding limit; signatory union contracts; and NIGP commodity codes. Up to three past client references are recorded per vendor, each with the client name, contract value, percent self-performed, date of work, and a description of the work. Geographic fields include city, state, ZIP, borough, latitude and longitude, community board, council district, BIN, BBL, 2020
